name: bowmo, Inc.
summary: bowmo, Inc. delivers intelligent software solutions designed for the staffing and recruitment industries. The company's core offering, the V-RPO platform, leverages proprietary artificial intelligence technology to automate recruitment processes with its advanced AI-based matching engine. This platform also provides sophisticated tools, including video interviewing, as well as cultural and technical assessments. Beyond its software, bowmo offers managed recruiting as a service, allowing clients to outsource the complete management of their recruiting needs. Founded in 2015, the company maintains its headquarters in New York, New York.
